svg.title: Which calls does the Authorizer check?
svg.desc: A call from a person or an external system passes the credential check and the Authorizer before dispatch, while a policy and the code of the application issue to dispatch directly, held to what the contract names.
svg.text: verifies the signature, builds the actor

g.text: A person sends a call with a credential.
An external system sends a call with its own credential.
The check passes the actor of a verified credential on.
The Authorizer allows the call, or dispatch refuses it.
Dispatch delivers an event to a policy.
The policy issues a command that its declaration names.
As a :system actor, the code issues what by: names.
